description_zh: 删除一个生命周期管理策略
kebab_example: aliyun nas delete-lifecycle-policy --file-system-id 31a8e40000 --lifecycle-policy-name lifecyclepolicy1 --lifecycle-policy-id lc-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteLifecyclePolicy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the lifecycle policy. The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter.

Optional for General-purpose NAS file systems. If this parameter is provided, it takes precedence over LifecyclePolicyId. If left empty, LifecyclePolicyId is used
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期管理策略名称。 长度为 3~64 个字符，必须以大写字母或小写字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。

通用型 NAS 文件系统选填，如果传入则以此为准，没有传入则以 LifecyclePolicyId 为准
parameters.name: lifecycle_policy_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lifecycle policy. Required for the CPFS for Lingjun file systems
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期策略的 ID。
CPFS 智算版 文件系统必填
parameters.name: lifecycle_policy_id
